Kan du förklara det.en: Can you explain what you mean?

texto: Keep shifts, ask for clarification and summarize a group agreement. **Kan du förklara det** means «Can you explain what you mean?». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 1 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
